# The pair to As II — same 4s2.4p2 ground, Z one higher. So the n=4
# block now holds TWO isoelectronic pairs:
#      4s2.4p   one outside :  As III, Se IV
#      4s2.4p2  two outside :  As II,  Se III
# ** SE III USES LS TERMS WHERE As II USED BARE DIGIT PAIRS, on the
#    SAME 4s2.4p.(2P*).nl configurations. NIST writes the same physical
#    structure in two orthographies one Z apart. That is the fifth
#    instance in this fetch of the notation varying independently of the
#    physics — and it is the strongest argument yet that the index must
#    key on STRUCTURE and not on the printed symbol. **
